Answer · Kinde cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $0/mo on Free · 50k users: $716.25/mo on Pro · 100k users: $1533.85/mo on Plus.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Free lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 10 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Free lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 2 other plans (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: Plus at $718.85/mo ranks #9 of 13, $8,455/yr more than Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection) (Firebase Auth / Identity Platform’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: Plus at $1533.85/mo ranks #7 of 13, $17,755/yr more than Supabase Auth Pro (platform) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection) (Supabase Auth’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).

As of 2026-10-31, from 25 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. Kinde pricing FAQ

How much does Kinde cost at 10k, 50k and 100k users?

10k users: $0/mo on Free; 50k users: $716.25/mo on Pro; 100k users: $1533.85/mo on Plus. Cheapest verified Kinde plan, monthly USD list price, no SSO, from https://kinde.com/pricing/ (checked 2026-10-31).
